clue_3: He became his boyhood club's all-time leading point-scorer, breaking a record that had stood for half a century
clue_4: He was the halfback when South Sydney broke their 43-year premiership drought in 2014, but the club's refusal to offer more than a one-year extension pushed him to Brisbane in 2022
clue_5: As Broncos captain he suffered the 2023 grand final collapse, then lifted the trophy at last in 2025 at age 35
clue_6: South Sydney and Brisbane halfback, 2014 premiership winner, Souths' record point-scorer and the captain who led the Broncos to the 2025 title
facts: Reynolds invited injured teammate Billy Walters to lift the 2025 premiership trophy alongside him.
He is among the most prolific field-goal kickers in premiership history.
South Sydney's 2014 triumph was their first title since 1971.
